description: Returns a group as its page shows it to the signed-in player: members (ids for create_battle's opponentIds), the leaderboard, recent finished games and your unfinished ones, its current hidden-list games, and its league with the table, your fixtures, and once every game is played its winners. An open fixture's start is the create_battle input that plays it for the league. A private group shows only its name until you are a member. Requires mcp:read.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

token.description: The group token, from list_my_events or its invite link.

name: get_my_group
title: Read one of my groups
